_comment: Test queries for Fase 3 (docs/plan-schema-grounding.md sec 5.2). Three queries per fixture, each exercising a different selection.select_tables() strategy: a table-name match, a column-only match, and a generic query with no relational terms (forces strategy="all"). 'notes' records the selection behavior observed with select_tables(max_tables=12, fk_expansion_depth=1) at the time these queries were picked (tests/fixtures/schema/, this file's sibling snapshots) -- it documents intent, it is not asserted by any test.

small.query: Add a discount code field to orders
Index the sku column for faster lookup
small.notes: lexical; matched=[products], related=[order_items] via FK closure

small.query: Improve error handling in the api

medium.query: Add a due date field to tasks
medium.notes: lexical; matched=[task_comments, task_labels, tasks, attachments], related=[labels, projects, users]. Deliberately avoids the earlier 'update task status' query, which also matched invoices via the shared status column and mixed two FK clusters.

medium.query: Add an index on the amount_cents column
medium.notes: lexical; matched=[invoice_line_items, invoices, payments], related=[organizations]. amount_cents does not appear in any table name, only columns.

hostile_naming.query: Add a phone number column to Cliente
hostile_naming.notes: lexical; matched=[Cliente, commandes, facturas] -- commandes/facturas pulled in via the 'cliente' token inside their id_cliente/clienteId columns, not via declared FK (facturas->Cliente has no declared FK). related=[commande_lignes] via commandes' real FK. Demonstrates convention-agnostic, FK-independent lexical matching.

hostile_naming.query: Add an index on the montoTotal column
hostile_naming.notes: lexical; matched=[facturas] only -- single clean column-only match
